name: chhath-geet-website1
description: A front-end Chhath Puja music experience built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It keeps the original song-reactive theme idea and adds the 107-item song catalogue shown on Chhath Geet Gatha, plus a four-day ritual guide, preparation checklist, serving-scaled thekua ingredient list, ghat gallery, better search, singer filtering, favourites, queue search, custom song addition, and responsive navigation.
